I will put manure from home on this maize plot, and I will also buy a little fertilizer if I get the cash in time. I have seen people nearby get better maize when they use improved seed with some fertilizer, but I will not go heavy because rain in Dodoma can fail and money is tight. I will not irrigate, and I will not buy pesticide because I usually manage with hand weeding and watching the crop.
